entries.subject: The color of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 3,600 K (Xuan et al. 2024), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white.

entries.subject: A Gaia BP/RP spectrum of this star as the color
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 has no BP/RP spectrum that describes this star alone, so the paper temperature gives the color.
entries.revisitWhen: Gaia publishes a spectrum of this star alone.

entries.subject: Limb darkening of the sphere
entries.finding: No fit of this star's limb exists, so the sphere is darkened by the quadratic Johnson V law Claret and Bloemen (2011) compute from ATLAS model atmospheres at 3,600 K and log g 4.04, from the record's mass and radius: a model. It replaced the uniform disc of the first version.
